chunks: And it is narrated from Samāʿah, who said:
I asked him about cupping and shaving the nape during the months of hajj. He said: “There is no harm, and there is no harm in using nūrah or the siwāk.”

key_terms.السِّوَاكِ: the toothstick used for cleaning the teeth
key_terms.بِالنُّورَةِ: with depilatory paste used for hair removal
key_terms.حَلْقِ الْقَفَا: shaving the back of the neck
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm or objection

ai.seo_question: Is cupping, shaving the nape, or using nūrah and siwāk allowed during the months of hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about certain acts of grooming during the months of hajj. It states that cupping, shaving the nape, using depilatory substance, and using the siwāk are permissible and carry no harm in this context.
